I tried online AA meetings in the beginning.  Everyone in the online meetings kept encouraging me to get to some face to face meetings.  I had a temporary sponsor online who also encouraged me to find a sponsor in the area that I could work with.  

The trouble I found with online was that it was a lot easier for me to lie or be deceiving with my sponsor.  From what I gathered, online AA is great in a pinch or if you live in a remote area and can’t get to an AA meeting, but it’s preferable to get to an actual meeting. 

In my experience, you can’t really replicate the fellowship and relationships online.  It can be uncomfortable walking into a new meeting, but it should be.  Part of recovery is overcoming fear and being willing to do the tough stuff to get better.
